title: वर्षा
description: Lekhnath Paudyal's poem "वर्षा" depicts the arrival of the monsoon season, comparing the thundering clouds and lightning to a revolutionary, and celebrating how the rains revive parched vegetation and bring coolness and renewal.

rights.basis: Author died 1966; public domain since 2016 (Nepal's Copyright Act 2059: life + 50 years).

summary: घनघोर बादल, बिजुली, वर्षा, खोला र हरियालीले रूप फेरिएको वर्षायामको चित्र।
